card.name: Single digits inside numbers in trial data
card.fires_on: A single digit token that starts or sits inside a multi-digit number or a count, mostly in clinical trial results such as patient counts, percentages and doses. It also fires on page or volume numbers in citations.

modes.label: Digit in trial figures
modes.description: A digit starting a count or percentage in adverse event or lab tables.

modes.label: Digit in dose or group counts
modes.description: A digit after 'and' or '+' naming a second dose group or patient count.

modes.label: Digit in citations or survey results
modes.description: A digit in a volume number or percentage outside drug labels.

card.plain: It marks a single digit that is part of a number in study results, such as a patient count or percent.
